text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Charcoal fine-knit fitted camisole and tiny matching open cropped cardigan with elbow sleeves, washed blue flared jeans with two stacked front waist buttons, dark footwear barely visible.。配饰：深灰轻薄长围巾；黑色褶皱圆形手提包；棕色大框太阳镜；细银色手链。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create one complete photorealistic wardrobe reference board on a pure white seamless background. Reference image 1 is the exact approved hollow garment set: preserve its clothes, shoes, material, color and cut. Reference image 2 is the source fashion board; use ONLY position left (rNcM = row N column M; two rows four columns for boards 3–7, left/right for the two-look boards). Add ONLY these matching accessories from that source position: 深灰轻薄长围巾；黑色褶皱圆形手提包；棕色大框太阳镜；细银色手链. Put the full garment set centrally and arrange the listed accessories clearly beside it, one each; earrings/gloves as pairs. Keep detachable accessories separate and recognizable; no repeated clothing. There is NO PERSON or visible mannequin. All shoes are EMPTY, no human feet or toes. Any open garment gaps show pure white background, never skin. Sheer tights are hollow fabric with no flesh inside. Entire outfit and all accessories fit uncropped within generous white margins. Soft neutral studio lighting, faithful fabric and metal texture. Portrait 2:3. No title, labels, text, logos or watermarks.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
